$comment: Shared-patch baseline (U-L3-01). Read by script/check-shared-patches.ts and script/check-opencode-annotations.ts. Each shared upstream file that Kilo adds or changes needs an entry: rung (3 = seam patch, 4 = feature patch) and the missing seam. `unmarked` allows lines without markers and states why. Raise a limit only in the PR that adds the patch, and lower it when a patch goes away.

.github/workflows/check.yml.seam: CI triggers and gates: run `check` on push to Kilo's `v2` integration branch (upstream's v2 line is `dev`) and for every pull request, so stacked v2 PRs that target another PR branch are checked; skip `lint:changed` on upstream sync PRs (branch `sync-v*`), whose changed files are upstream's and fail upstream's lint too. No seam: workflow triggers and step conditions cannot be extended from outside the file.

.github/workflows/test.yml.seam: CI triggers: run the unit and e2e matrix on push to Kilo's `v2` integration branch (upstream's v2 line is `dev`). Skip the `affected` job, and with it the e2e job that needs it: the e2e job tests only `packages/app` and `packages/session-ui`, which Kilo removed (`skipFiles` in script/upstream/utils/config.ts). One job-level line, so upstream changes to the e2e steps still merge cleanly. No seam: workflow triggers and job conditions cannot be extended from outside the file.

.gitignore.seam: Ignore Kilo-only local dev profiles (`.kilo-v2-dev/` from script/dev-isolated.ts and `.kilo-dev/`), `telemetry-id`, generated dependency installs, merge reports, and JetBrains state under `.kilo/`, and `packages/app/.artifacts/`. No seam: root gitignore rules cannot live in a Kilo-owned file. Reconciled by 3-way merge during upstream syncs; goes away when the Kilo host owns the root and dev entry (U-E0-01).
.gitignore.unmarked: Twelve ignore patterns. A gitignore pattern line cannot carry an inline comment, so each pattern is preceded by a `# kilocode_change:` comment line.

README.md.seam: Show the generated Kilo v2 migration progress map (badge, treemap, history from migration-tracking/progress/) on the branch front page. Visibility only, no behavior. No seam: the repository README is a single upstream-owned file, and a Kilo-owned README cannot be the front page of the same repository. Goes away when the map is published outside the repository (for example GitHub Pages) or when the Kilo host owns the repository root (U-E0-01).

package.json.seam: Root `dev` script runs script/dev-isolated.ts, so `bun dev` never uses the installed OpenCode or Kilo data. Goes away when the Kilo host owns the dev entry (U-E0-01). Root `lint` script runs only `oxlint`: its ast-grep and `script/sdk-docs.ts` steps check `packages/gui-extensions`, which Kilo removed (`skipFiles`).

packages/cli/script/app-assets.ts.seam: Build an empty web UI archive when `packages/app` does not exist, because Kilo removed it (`skipFiles` in script/upstream/utils/config.ts). One generic condition covers the release build (`build.ts`) and the Node build (`build-node.ts`). The server then answers non-API paths with 404, as on v1. No seam: the build scripts call `buildAppArchive` directly.

packages/cli/script/service-smoke.ts.seam: Accept a 404 for the web UI shell in the compiled service smoke test, because the Kilo build embeds no web UI (`packages/app` removed). The API, authentication, and plugin checks still run. No seam: the smoke script has no option to skip the web UI check.

packages/core/package.json.seam: Runtime dependency on `@kilocode/gateway-core` for the built-in `KiloGatewayPlugin` adapter (`packages/core/src/kilocode/gateway.ts`). Goes away when the Kilo host registers the Gateway plugin outside `@opencode/core` (U-E0-01).

packages/core/src/plugin/provider.ts.seam: Replace upstream `KiloPlugin` (which stamps OpenCode referer and title headers) with `KiloGatewayPlugin` (`packages/core/src/kilocode/gateway.ts`) until the Kilo host registers built-in Kilo plugins via `SdkPlugins.register` (U-E0-01).

packages/core/test/plugin/provider-kilo..seam: Update the built-in `ProviderPlugins` assertion to expect `kilocode.gateway` in place of `opencode.provider.kilo`.

packages/sdk/script/verify-package.ts.seam: Pack `@kilocode/gateway-core` before `@opencode/core` in the workerd SDK verification script because `@opencode/core` depends on `@kilocode/gateway-core`.

packages/tui/src/component/dialog-integr.seam: Prompt for Personal Account vs Team (`chooseKiloAccount`) after a Kilo Gateway login completes, before closing or chaining the integration dialog. `TuiPlugin` has no post-integration-connect hook.

packages/tui/src/plugin/builtins.ts.seam: Register the built-in `KiloTeams` TUI plugin (`/teams`, `/team`, `/org`, `/orgs`) until the Kilo host owns the TUI built-in plugin list (U-E0-01).

turbo.json.seam: Register `@kilocode/gateway-core#test` in Turborepo so `bun turbo test --affected` runs the Gateway core unit and boundary tests in CI.
